# Output coboundary in the 4+1D Majorana stacking formula

**Phase convention:** physical, as fixed in the [formula guide](../FORMULA_GUIDE.md#phase-convention): the forward F move carries $`\nu`$, the consistency loop runs forward along $`D`$ and back along $`N`$, the insertions are $`X=P\Gamma`$ and $`\bar X=\bar P\Gamma^\dagger`$, and coefficients are signed minimal representatives.

This intermediate output-gauge step precedes the current [compact-Majorana phase change](FOUR_DIMENSIONAL_MAJORANA_PHASE.md). Its explicit expression rewrites the Majorana cochain contribution of the
face construction. No summand is moved to another contribution,
including terms containing the Majorana differential.

The output-gauge step is

```math
\mathcal{ℰ}_5^\gamma\longmapsto\mathcal{ℰ}_5^\gamma-d_{s_1}B_4^{\mathrm{out}}.
```

On the ordered four-simplex, its complete output gauge is

```math
\begin{aligned}
B_4^{\mathrm{out}}={}&\frac12\sum_{\eta\in\mathcal K_4}
          \prod_{(x,f)\in\eta}x(f)\\
&-\frac14(\beta^-n_3+\beta^-n'_3)
       \cup_3(n_3\cup_3n'_3).
\end{aligned}
```

The sum contains exactly **419 physical-face products**, listed in the
[complete coefficient table](coefficients/FOUR_DIMENSIONAL_MAJORANA_STACKING_GAUGE.json).
Every row is one product of the explicitly named physical cochains on
explicit faces of (01234). Every binary coefficient is one. The remaining
bracket contains two integer cup terms. No field on another physical
simplex or unspecified primitive is needed to use this gauge.

The inverse change adds the displayed coboundary. The obstruction function
is unchanged because the twisted differential squares to zero. The output
phase therefore represents the same bosonic cohomology class. The formula
and this gauge hold for open Majorana cochains; imposing that their
differentials vanish is unnecessary.

All integer cups, canonical binary lifts, and Bocksteins use the conventions
in the main formula guide. The sum inside an open Bockstein is a binary
sum before its canonical lift.

## P-move rephasing to the closed-Majorana law

The [complete Majorana contribution](FOUR_DIMENSIONAL.md#eq-theta5) also contains
$`d_{s_1}\big(\tfrac12b_4+\tfrac14n_3\cup_2n'_3\big)`$, a fixed local phase of
the P move. On the ordered four-simplex

```math
b_4=\sum_{\eta\in\mathcal K_4^{\rm P}}
          \prod_{(x,f)\in\eta}x(f).
```

The sum contains exactly **129 products** of the face values of
$`n_3,n'_3,\omega_2,s_1`$ on faces of (01234) that contain the vertex 0, listed in the
[coefficient table](coefficients/FOUR_DIMENSIONAL_MAJORANA_STACKING_REPHASING.json);
every coefficient is one. With this phase and the polynomial
$`\Theta_5`$ of the complete contribution, the Majorana contribution at
$`n_2=n'_2=0`$ equals the [closed-Majorana law](MAJORANA_AND_ENDPOINTS.md#eq-m7-4d).
The polynomial is the Eilenberg–Zilber primitive, on closed inputs, of the
half-valued part of the difference between that law and the contribution without
this phase; on open Majorana cochains it is evaluated with the same faces.
As for the output gauge, the obstruction function is unchanged.
